intent: Quantify cross-dataset disagreement; no model fitting, tuning, independent accuracy score or approval claim
signed_difference: M-D; positive means model/baseline is larger
reference_definition: D is comparator, not assumed truth
area_equivalent: Native surface/volume translated using each country's EXISTING frozen model2020/TEMPO2020 ratio. These are new conditional comparison scenarios, NOT externally published GFA estimates. No extra height/storey assumptions fitted.
no_double_evidence: OBAT equivalent percent difference equals its footprint comparison algebraically; inherited2020 proxy identity excluded from substantive summaries. Do not combine dataset families into an accuracy score.
growth: 100*((M_end/M_start-1)-(S_end/S_start-1)), percentage points; GFA and source physical growth remain distinct
missing: Keep missing/unqualified cells blank with reasons, never zero fill. PSE source-conditioned supplement kept in country grid, excluded from core194 aggregates.
global_summary: Sum M and D over exactly the same available core194 country cohort for each dataset/year; separately report count and excluded countries
temporal: Only source-native epochs used. No interpolation or annual/future OBAT/GHSL observations fabricated.
scope: Total GFA area-equivalent comparison only. No external RES/NRES GFA claimed from footprint/use or volume shares.
